Summary: [EDS-DA] Provision AEM Edge Delivery Services project repository
Description:
As a development team, we need an EDS GitHub repository provisioned with the AEM Boilerplate so that we have the foundational codebase to begin development.

Tasks:
- Create GitHub repository from aem-boilerplate template
- Configure fstab.yaml for content source (Google Drive or SharePoint)
- Validate code sync by accessing .page and .live URLs
- Set up branch protection rules on main
- Add team members with appropriate access
Acceptance Criteria:
- GitHub repo created from aem-boilerplate
- fstab.yaml configured and committed
- .page preview URL accessible and rendering default content
- .live URL accessible
- Branch protection enabled on main
- All team members have repo access

Summary: [EDS-DA] Set up content source (Google Drive / SharePoint)
Description:
As a content author, we need the content source (Google Drive or SharePoint) configured and connected to the EDS project so that authored documents render as web pages.

Tasks:
- Create shared drive / SharePoint site for content
- Set up folder structure (drafts, published)
- Share with AEM code sync service account
- Verify document-to-page rendering pipeline
- Create sample index document
Acceptance Criteria:
- Shared drive/SharePoint site created
- Folder structure established
- AEM service account has read access
- Sample document created and renders at preview URL
- Index (homepage) document renders correctly

Summary: [EDS-DA] Configure local development environment
Description:
As a developer, I need a documented local development setup so that all team members can run the EDS project locally with hot-reload.

Tasks:
- Document Node.js version requirements
- Create package.json with AEM CLI dependency
- Document 'aem up' local dev server startup
- Verify localhost:3000 renders content
- Create CONTRIBUTING.md with setup instructions
Acceptance Criteria:
- All developers can run 'npm install && aem up' successfully
- localhost:3000 serves content with live reload
- Setup documented in README or CONTRIBUTING.md
- Minimum Node.js version specified

Summary: [EDS-DA] Establish coding standards and linting configuration
Description:
As a development team, we need ESLint and Stylelint configured with project-specific rules so that code quality is consistent from Day 1.

Tasks:
- Configure ESLint with Airbnb rules (AEM standard)
- Configure Stylelint for CSS
- Set up pre-commit hooks (husky + lint-staged)
- Verify 'npm run lint' passes on boilerplate code
- Document coding conventions
Acceptance Criteria:
- ESLint configured and passing on all existing JS files
- Stylelint configured and passing on all existing CSS files
- Pre-commit hooks prevent unlinted code from being committed
- 'npm run lint' and 'npm run lint:fix' scripts working
- Coding standards documented

Summary: [EDS-DA] Define and implement global design tokens (CSS custom properties)
Description:
As a designer/developer, we need brand-aligned CSS custom properties (colors, typography, spacing) defined so that all blocks inherit consistent styling.

Tasks:
- Extract design tokens from brand guidelines or Figma
- Define CSS custom properties in styles/styles.css
- Set up font-face declarations in styles/fonts.css
- Configure responsive breakpoints (600px, 900px, 1200px)
- Document design token usage
Acceptance Criteria:
- CSS custom properties defined for colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
- Font files added to /fonts/ directory
- @font-face declarations in fonts.css
- Responsive breakpoints documented and consistent
- Token documentation/cheat sheet available

Summary: [EDS-DA] Create page template skeleton (header, footer, section structure)
Description:
As an author, we need the basic page template structure (header, footer, default section styling) implemented so that content renders in a standard page layout.

Tasks:
- Implement nav/header block loading in scripts.js
- Implement footer block loading
- Create header and footer documents in content source
- Style default section containers (max-width, padding)
- Validate responsive layout on mobile/tablet/desktop
Acceptance Criteria:
- Header loads and displays navigation
- Footer loads and displays footer content
- Default sections have proper max-width and responsive padding
- Page renders correctly at mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1440px)
- No layout shift (CLS) on page load

Summary: [EDS-DA] Set up CI/CD pipeline and quality gates
Description:
As a team, we need automated checks on pull requests so that code quality and performance are enforced before merge.

Tasks:
- Configure GitHub Actions for lint checks on PR
- Set up Lighthouse CI for performance scoring
- Configure AEM Code Sync status checks
- Define merge requirements (lint pass + code sync green)
- Document PR workflow
Acceptance Criteria:
- GitHub Actions workflow runs lint on every PR
- Lighthouse CI runs and reports score
- AEM Code Sync check shows green on successful sync
- PRs cannot merge without passing required checks
- PR template includes preview URL requirement

Summary: [EDS-DA] Define content model and block inventory
Description:
As a content strategist, we need a documented content model defining which blocks are needed, their authoring patterns, and their content structure so that development and authoring are aligned.

Tasks:
- Analyze target site/design for content patterns
- List all required blocks with descriptions
- Define authoring pattern for each block (table structure, naming)
- Identify which blocks exist in Block Collection vs. custom
- Create prioritized block backlog
Acceptance Criteria:
- Block inventory document created with all identified blocks
- Each block has: name, description, authoring pattern, priority
- Blocks categorized: available (boilerplate/collection) vs. custom build
- Block backlog prioritized for Sprint 1+
- Content model reviewed with authoring team

Summary: [EDS-DA] Configure metadata and SEO foundations
Description:
As an SEO specialist, we need metadata handling, robots.txt, sitemap, and Open Graph tags configured so that the site is search-engine ready from the start.

Tasks:
- Configure metadata block handling in content documents
- Set up head.html with standard meta tags, OG tags, favicon
- Create robots.txt
- Configure sitemap.xml generation
- Set up canonical URL handling
Acceptance Criteria:
- Metadata from content documents renders in page <head>
- Open Graph tags render correctly (test with social debuggers)
- robots.txt accessible and correctly configured
- Sitemap generation configured
- Canonical URLs set properly
- Favicon configured in head.html

Summary: [EDS-DA] Set up authoring documentation and content guidelines
Description:
As a content author, I need documentation on how to create content in the new document-based authoring model so that I can begin creating pages independently.

Tasks:
- Create authoring quick-start guide
- Document block authoring patterns (how to create each block)
- Create content template documents for authors to copy
- Document image handling guidelines
- Set up example/reference pages
Acceptance Criteria:
- Quick-start guide document created and shared
- Block authoring guide with visual examples
- Template documents available for authors to duplicate
- Image sizing/format guidelines documented
- At least 2 reference pages created showing all block patterns

Summary: [ACCS] Provision AEM as a Cloud Service environment
Description:
As an infrastructure team, we need AEMaaCS environments (Dev, Stage, Prod) provisioned via Cloud Manager so that the team has target environments for development and testing.

Tasks:
- Request AEMaaCS program creation in Cloud Manager
- Provision Dev environment
- Provision Stage environment
- Confirm Prod environment allocation
- Document environment URLs and access
Acceptance Criteria:
- AEMaaCS program created in Cloud Manager
- Dev environment provisioned and accessible
- Stage environment provisioned and accessible
- Prod environment confirmed in plan
- Environment URLs documented
- Admin access verified for all environments

Summary: [ACCS] Configure AEM DAM folder structure and permissions
Description:
As a DAM administrator, we need the target folder taxonomy created in AEM Assets with appropriate permission groups so that migrated content lands in a governed structure.

Tasks:
- Create top-level DAM folder structure per design
- Create AEM user groups aligned to access model
- Apply folder-level permissions (ACLs)
- Verify permission boundaries with test users
- Document permission matrix
Acceptance Criteria:
- All designed top-level folders created under /content/dam/
- User groups created matching permission design
- ACLs applied and verified (read/write boundaries correct)
- Test users can only access designated folders
- Permission matrix documented and approved

Summary: [ACCS] Design and configure metadata schema
Description:
As a DAM administrator, we need custom metadata schemas configured in AEM so that migrated assets can carry all required business metadata.

Tasks:
- Define metadata schema fields (from metadata mapping document)
- Create custom metadata schema form in AEM
- Apply schema to relevant DAM folders
- Create required dropdown value lists
- Test schema with manual asset upload
Acceptance Criteria:
- Custom metadata schema created in AEM
- Schema applied to correct folders
- All custom fields render in asset properties editor
- Dropdown fields populated with correct values
- Required vs. optional fields enforced correctly
- Schema tested with manual upload of sample assets

Summary: [ACCS] Create tag taxonomy in AEM
Description:
As a content team, we need the tag taxonomy created in AEM so that assets can be categorized and searchable via tags during and after migration.

Tasks:
- Design tag namespace hierarchy
- Create root namespaces in AEM Tag Admin
- Populate tag tree with all required values
- Map source keywords/categories to AEM tag paths
- Export tag-to-source-value mapping for migration scripts
Acceptance Criteria:
- Tag namespaces created in AEM
- All tag values populated per taxonomy design
- Tag hierarchy navigable in AEM Tag Admin
- Mapping CSV available (source_value → aem_tag_path)
- Tags assignable to assets in AEM UI

Summary: [ACCS] Configure asset processing profiles
Description:
As a DAM administrator, we need processing profiles configured so that images, videos, and documents are automatically processed (renditions, thumbnails, transcoding) upon upload.

Tasks:
- Configure image processing profile (rendition sizes)
- Configure video processing profile (if Dynamic Media enabled)
- Configure document extraction settings
- Assign profiles to relevant DAM folders
- Test processing with sample uploads
Acceptance Criteria:
- Image processing profile generates required rendition sizes
- Video transcoding profile configured (if applicable)
- Document text extraction enabled
- Profiles assigned to correct folders
- Sample assets of each type processed correctly on upload

Summary: [ACCS] Set up Connected Assets or Dynamic Media (if applicable)
Description:
As a delivery team, we need asset delivery mechanism configured (Connected Assets for EDS or Dynamic Media for optimized delivery) so that published assets are performant.

Tasks:
- Determine delivery strategy (Connected Assets vs. Dynamic Media vs. direct DAM URLs)
- Configure chosen delivery mechanism
- Test asset delivery URLs from EDS pages
- Document URL patterns for development team
- Validate performance (CDN caching, image optimization)
Acceptance Criteria:
- Asset delivery strategy decided and documented
- Configuration completed for chosen mechanism
- Assets accessible via delivery URLs
- URL pattern documentation available for EDS developers
- Performance validated (load time, CDN headers correct)

Summary: [ACCS] Configure Cloud Manager pipelines for AEM customizations
Description:
As a DevOps engineer, we need Cloud Manager CI/CD pipelines configured so that any AEM customizations (OSGi configs, custom workflows, metadata schemas as code) can be deployed consistently.

Tasks:
- Set up Cloud Manager Git repository
- Configure build pipeline (Dev)
- Configure promotion pipeline (Dev → Stage → Prod)
- Define deployment strategy
- Test pipeline with initial commit
Acceptance Criteria:
- Cloud Manager repo set up with AEM project archetype
- Dev pipeline builds and deploys successfully
- Promotion pipeline configured for Stage and Prod
- Pipeline runs on git push (or manual trigger as configured)
- Test deployment verified on Dev environment

Summary: [ACCS] Define user groups, roles, and access control model
Description:
As an administrator, we need AEM user groups and roles defined so that authors, reviewers, and admins have appropriate access levels across the DAM.

Tasks:
- Define role matrix (Admin, Author, Reviewer, ReadOnly)
- Create AEM groups in Admin Console
- Configure IMS/SAML SSO integration (if required)
- Map existing team members to roles
- Test access boundaries per role
Acceptance Criteria:
- Role matrix documented and approved
- AEM groups created with correct permissions
- SSO/IMS integration tested (if applicable)
- Team members mapped to appropriate groups
- Access boundaries verified (can/cannot actions per role)

Summary: [Assets-Migration] S3 bucket inventory and assessment
Description:
As a migration engineer, we need a complete inventory of the source S3 bucket so that we can plan batch sizing, identify edge cases, and estimate migration duration.

Tasks:
- Run S3 inventory export (all objects with metadata)
- Analyze: total count, total size, distribution by type
- Identify oversized assets (>2GB)
- Identify assets with special characters in names
- Identify duplicate assets (hash comparison)
- Generate assessment report
Acceptance Criteria:
- Complete S3 inventory exported (CSV/JSON)
- Summary report: total assets, total size (GB/TB), breakdown by type
- Edge cases identified: oversized files, special characters, duplicates
- Folder depth analysis completed
- Assessment report reviewed by migration lead

Summary: [Assets-Migration] Define folder transformation rules
Description:
As a migration architect, we need documented folder mapping rules so that S3 source paths can be programmatically transformed to AEM DAM target paths.

Tasks:
- Document all transformation rule types needed (rename, flatten, merge, split, conditional)
- Write rules for each source folder pattern
- Define default handling for unmatched paths
- Define exclusion rules (temp files, thumbnails, etc.)
- Review and approve rules with stakeholders
Acceptance Criteria:
- Folder mapping rules document complete (CSV/JSON format)
- All source folders have a matching rule or explicit exclusion
- Default handling defined for unmatched assets
- Exclusion list documented with justification
- Rules reviewed and approved by DAM owner

Summary: [Assets-Migration] Build metadata extraction and transformation pipeline
Description:
As a migration engineer, we need an automated pipeline that extracts metadata from the source database/CSV, joins it to assets, and transforms it to AEM-compatible format.

Tasks:
- Build database/CSV metadata extraction script
- Implement join logic (metadata record ↔ asset by key)
- Apply field-level transformations per mapping document
- Generate AEM-compatible metadata CSV output
- Handle edge cases (missing metadata, duplicates, orphans)
Acceptance Criteria:
- Metadata extraction script runs against source successfully
- Join logic links >95% of assets to metadata records
- Orphan report generated (assets without metadata, metadata without assets)
- Transformed metadata CSV passes AEM format validation
- Multi-value fields correctly pipe-delimited
- Date fields in ISO 8601 format

Summary: [Assets-Migration] Build folder transformation and staging script
Description:
As a migration engineer, we need an automated script that copies assets from source S3 to staging S3 with the new folder structure applied so that Bulk Import can ingest from a pre-structured source.

Tasks:
- Implement path transformation engine (apply rules from mapping doc)
- Build S3-to-S3 copy pipeline with new paths
- Handle filename sanitization (remove special characters)
- Generate source-to-target mapping log
- Build validation: count source vs. staged assets
Acceptance Criteria:
- Transformation script processes full inventory
- Assets copied to staging S3 with correct target paths
- Filenames sanitized per AEM naming rules
- Complete source→target mapping CSV generated
- Asset count matches (source minus exclusions = staged)

Summary: [Assets-Migration] Configure AEMaaCS Bulk Import for S3
Description:
As a migration engineer, we need AEMaaCS Bulk Import configured and tested with S3 connectivity so that we have a proven ingestion mechanism.

Tasks:
- Create IAM user with minimum S3 permissions for AEM
- Configure Bulk Import in AEM (S3 connector settings)
- Test connectivity with 10-asset sample
- Configure import settings (overwrite mode, metadata CSV)
- Document configuration for team
Acceptance Criteria:
- IAM user/role created with s3:GetObject + s3:ListBucket
- Bulk Import configuration saved in AEM
- Connectivity test passes (AEM reads from staging S3)
- 10-asset test import succeeds with correct folder placement
- Metadata CSV applied correctly to test assets
- Configuration documented

Summary: [Assets-Migration] Execute dry run migration (validation sample)
Description:
As a QA team, we need a dry run migration of 500-1000 representative assets so that we validate the end-to-end pipeline before full-scale execution.

Tasks:
- Select representative sample (all types, all rule patterns, edge cases)
- Execute full pipeline: transform → stage → import → metadata
- Run validation checklist against imported sample
- Measure performance metrics (throughput, error rate)
- Document findings and required fixes
Acceptance Criteria:
- 500-1000 assets migrated end-to-end to AEM Dev/Stage
- All assets at correct target paths
- Metadata correctly applied (spot-check 50 assets)
- Renditions generated successfully
- Error rate <1%
- Performance metrics captured and extrapolated to full volume
- Issues documented with remediation plan

Summary: [Assets-Migration] Define migration batch strategy and schedule
Description:
As a project manager, we need a documented batch strategy with schedule so that the full migration can be executed in a controlled, trackable manner.

Tasks:
- Calculate total batches based on dry run throughput
- Group assets into logical batches (by folder, type, or priority)
- Define batch sequence (low-risk first, high-visibility last)
- Create migration schedule with dates and owners
- Define go/no-go checkpoints between batches
Acceptance Criteria:
- Batch strategy document complete
- Total batches defined with asset counts per batch
- Sequence and priority defined
- Schedule with target dates for each batch
- Checkpoints defined between batches
- Rollback criteria documented per batch

Summary: [Cross-Stream] Define integration architecture (EDS + ACCS)
Description:
As a solution architect, we need the integration pattern between EDS pages and AEM Assets documented so that developers know how to reference DAM assets from EDS content.

Tasks:
- Document how EDS pages reference AEM Assets (URL patterns)
- Define image optimization strategy (srcset, WebP, lazy loading)
- Document Dynamic Media URL construction (if applicable)
- Define fallback strategy for assets not yet migrated
- Create integration diagram
Acceptance Criteria:
- Integration architecture document created
- URL pattern for DAM asset references documented
- Image optimization approach defined and documented
- Dynamic Media URL format documented (if applicable)
- Fallback strategy for phased migration defined
- Architecture diagram created and reviewed

Summary: [Cross-Stream] Establish project communication and ceremonies
Description:
As a scrum master, we need sprint ceremonies, communication channels, and reporting cadence established so that the full team operates efficiently across all streams.

Tasks:
- Schedule recurring ceremonies (standup, planning, review, retro)
- Set up communication channels (Slack/Teams)
- Define cross-stream sync cadence
- Create status reporting template
- Define escalation paths
Acceptance Criteria:
- All ceremonies scheduled and recurring
- Communication channels created and team onboarded
- Cross-stream sync meeting scheduled (min weekly)
- Status report template agreed upon
- RACI matrix for escalations documented

Summary: [Cross-Stream] Set up project tracking and backlog management
Description:
As a project manager, we need Jira (or equivalent) configured with proper epics, components, and board views so that all three streams are trackable in a unified view.

Tasks:
- Create Jira project (or configure existing)
- Set up components: EDS-DA, ACCS, Assets-Migration, Cross-Stream
- Create epics for each major workstream
- Configure board views (team board, stream-specific views)
- Import Sprint 0 stories
Acceptance Criteria:
- Jira project configured with all components
- Epics created for each stream
- Board views configured (unified + per-stream)
- Sprint 0 stories imported and prioritized
- Team members added with correct roles

Summary: [Cross-Stream] Define Definition of Done (DoD) and quality criteria
Description:
As a team, we need an agreed Definition of Done so that all streams have consistent quality expectations for completing stories.

Tasks:
- Draft DoD covering code, content, and infrastructure work
- Include performance criteria (Lighthouse 100 for EDS)
- Include accessibility criteria (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Include documentation requirements
- Review and agree with full team
Acceptance Criteria:
- Definition of Done documented and agreed
- Covers: code quality, testing, documentation, review
- Performance criteria: Lighthouse >= 95 (target 100) for EDS
- Accessibility criteria: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
- All team members acknowledged and committed to DoD

Summary: [Cross-Stream] Security review and access provisioning
Description:
As a security lead, we need all access credentials, service accounts, and security configurations reviewed and provisioned so that the team can work securely across all platforms.

Tasks:
- Provision Adobe Admin Console access for team
- Set up GitHub access (repo permissions)
- Configure S3 access (IAM users/roles)
- Set up service accounts (AEM code sync, content source)
- Security review of all integration points
Acceptance Criteria:
- All team members have appropriate Adobe Admin Console access
- GitHub repo access granted per role
- S3 IAM credentials provisioned (migration team only)
- Service accounts created and documented
- Security review completed; no open vulnerabilities
- Credential management approach documented (vault/secrets)

Summary: [Cross-Stream] Create technical architecture document
Description:
As a solution architect, we need a consolidated technical architecture document covering all three streams so that the team has a shared understanding of the overall solution.

Tasks:
- Document EDS architecture (repo, content source, delivery)
- Document ACCS architecture (environments, pipelines, integrations)
- Document migration architecture (S3, staging, Bulk Import)
- Define integration touchpoints between streams
- Create architecture diagrams (C4 Level 1 & 2)
Acceptance Criteria:
- Technical architecture document created
- All three streams represented with clear boundaries
- Integration points between streams documented
- Architecture diagrams (system context + container level)
- Document reviewed and approved by tech leads
- Shared with full team

Summary: [Cross-Stream] Risk register and dependency tracking setup
Description:
As a project manager, we need a risk register and dependency tracker established so that cross-stream risks and blockers are visible and actively managed.

Tasks:
- Create risk register template
- Identify initial risks per stream
- Document cross-stream dependencies
- Define risk review cadence (weekly)
- Assign risk owners
Acceptance Criteria:
- Risk register created with initial entries per stream
- Cross-stream dependencies documented and linked
- Risk owners assigned for each identified risk
- Weekly risk review scheduled
- Escalation criteria defined for high/critical risks
